tasks.task: Implement Recommendation dataclass (AC: #1) Create dataclass in rustybt/validation/reporting.py Define priority, action, details, command fields Add severity labels (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) Add formatting method for CLI output Test: Unit tests for dataclass

Implement recommend_next_actions function (AC: #1) Query open bug findings (Priority 1) Query unclassified findings (Priority 2) Query incomplete strategies (Priority 3) Check documentation update needs (Priority 4) Sort actions by priority Test: Verify priority logic

Generate copy-pasteable commands (AC: #2) Generate rustybt-validate investigate --bugs for open bugs Generate rustybt-validate investigate --unclassified for unclassified Generate rustybt-validate run {session_id} for incomplete strategies Generate rustybt-validate docs generate for documentation Test: Verify command generation

Add CLI next command (AC: #2) Add next command to CLI main group Call recommend_next_actions for current state Display formatted recommendations with priorities Show copy-pasteable commands Test: CLI integration tests
Handle edge cases (AC: #1-2) Handle empty state (no sessions at all) Handle complete state (nothing to do) Handle multiple issues at same priority Test: Edge case tests
Write comprehensive tests (AC: #1-2) Test with open bugs Test with unclassified findings Test with incomplete strategies Test with mixed priorities Test with all complete

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given current validation state When next actions are queried Then prioritized Recommendation list is returned with: Priority 1 (HIGH) for open bugs, Priority 2 (MEDIUM) for unclassified findings, Priority 3 for incomplete strategies, Priority 4 (LOW) for documentation updates
CLI command rustybt-validate next displays Recommended Next Actions with priority labels [HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW], action descriptions, and copy-pasteable rustybt-validate commands
